description: A schedule table: standard columns for the kind plus a column per custom property. openings = doors and windows (type, width, height, sill, wall); rooms (area, gross area, perimeter, enclosed); walls (length, height, thickness, face area, openings); slabs; stairs (risers, riser height, going); columns; beams; ramps (rise, gradient, transitions, headroom); lifts; parking (bays, accessible bays, bay numbers per row); furniture; product = the Products schedule: each product (manufacturer, product, code) once, with quantity, items, levels, link and notes.

columns.description: Only these columns, in this order (titles as the schedule has them)

filters.description: Rows that pass every filter; over/under compare numbers in the column's units

group_by.description: Group rows by this column, each group followed by a subtotal row

report.description: A report the user saved (File → Schedules → Reports), by name: its columns, filters and totals (kind is then ignored)

totals.description: Number columns summed in subtotal and total rows

name: get_schedule
title: Get schedule
